Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from regular returns.
Because we sell food products, we cannot accept standard returns on opened food items like dried or freeze-dried fruits, vegetables, and beans. However, if an item arrives damaged or defective, we will work with you to provide a replacement or resolution.
For damaged items, we require photos of the damaged product and packaging to submit to our Quality Assurance team. Please also let us know within 24 hours of delivery and retain the item and packaging so we can help resolve it.
If you'd like us to set up a support request for your damaged item, please share your name and email address. Is there anything else I can help you with?
